cityQuote: Liverpool is the “pool of life.” The “liver,” according to an old view, is the seat of life — that which “makes to live.”

quoteAlternatives.attribution: Carl Jung, psychiatrist, Memories, Dreams, Reflections (1962), recalling a 1927 dream
quoteAlternatives.note: Short form of option 1. Jung never visited Liverpool; the line comes from his account of a dream set there. It is on the plaque under his bust in Mathew Street.
